observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor hall with wood floor, mirrors, and chandelier, likely a community gathering or cultural event
observation.dancers: large mixed group of adults, predominantly women, with a few men singing and drumming
observation.formation_and_space: semi-circle or group formation facing inward toward musicians and singing chorus
observation.posture: upright torso, relaxed knees, gentle bouncing weight shifts
observation.footwork: weight shifting from side to side and rhythmic stepping on the beat, low-resolution prevents seeing exact heel-toe details
observation.arms_and_hands: arms relaxed, bent at elbows, gesturing or swinging skirts; some holding objects like bags or cloths
observation.hips_and_torso: gentle hip sway and upper body movement responding to the rhythm
observation.partnering: solo dancing in the center with group surrounding and encouraging, no direct partner contact
observation.levels_jumps_turns: upright level, no jumps, occasional simple pivots or turns
observation.costume_and_props: traditional style skirts, dresses, head wraps in colorful and patterned fabrics; some women wearing boots
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement and weight transfer mechanics due to camera distance and video compression

signature_moments.what: group singing and swaying together in a semi-circle while individual dancers step forward
dancer stepping rhythmically with skirt movement in the center of the room
dancer performing energetic foot steps and arm gestures while turning slightly
dancer in green dress stepping lively with arms bent and skirts swishing
